proof_scope: canonical output contract and its broadcast runtime, exercised through the real run.sh against the real provider instruction files on this host, plus controlled live provider-discovery tests

claims.proves: one edit to output-contract.md reaches all five targets and reverts cleanly with no residue; check mode is the default and mutates nothing (md5 stable across a check run); repeated applies leave exactly one managed block per target, never appending a second; provider-specific content outside the block is byte-preserved, verified by diffing pre-block content against the pre-write backup for both CLAUDE.md (203 lines) and AGENTS.md (1004 lines); output styles are discovered by glob so a new style file needs no code edit; the Claude output style keeps parseable frontmatter on line 1 after the block is installed; the installed style loads and its content reaches the model, verified by a live session quoting its own contract heading; Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md and ignores a sibling AGENTS.md, verified by a controlled two-file test with distinct sentinels; backups are written outside every directory a provider scans so a timestamped copy can never load as a style or rule
claims.does_not_prove: that any model actually obeys the contract's rules in practice — installation is not obedience, and only a live session under the installed instructions can demonstrate it; that Gemini CLI and Cursor load their target files at all, since only the file writes were verified and no live probe was run against either provider; that a running session picks up an edit, since provider instructions load at session start and were never tested across a restart; that the contract's wording measurably reduces commit-status-over-results reporting, which is unmeasured

cases.input: append a probe token to output-contract.md, run apply
run.sh check against drifted and converged targets

assert: exactly one BEGIN marker per target

cases.input: diff pre-block content against pre-write backup for CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md
assert: Codex keeps '# Global Codex Agent Instructions' as line 1

cases.input: live claude -p under --settings outputStyle 'Clear technical', asked to quote its own contract heading
assert: returns '## Lead with the result, not the process'

cases.input: clean dir with AGENTS.md sentinel only, then AGENTS.md plus CLAUDE.md with distinct sentinels
assert: with both present only the CLAUDE.md sentinel appears
every provider therefore needs its own copy

cases.input: add a second style file, run apply
